title: Qwen3.8-Next MTP guide (RTX 6000 PRO): which memory tier carried the PLE table behind the 170 tok/s chart?
body:
**Q on the Qwen3.8-Next MTP guide** (unsloth.ai/docs/models/qwen3.8-next)

The guide's MTP chart says UD-Q4_K_XL reaches **170 tokens/s on 1× RTX 6000 PRO** (vs a ~100 tok/s baseline). Two things about that specific run aren't stated on the page and we'd like to record them verbatim in a provenance directory of Qwen local-run setups (a public, source-backed companion dataset — so it's builder-facing provenance, not a support ticket):

1. The UD-Q4_K_XL file is ~111.3 GB while the RTX 6000 PRO card is 96 GB. Which tier carried the PLE table on that run — page-locked host, pageable host, CPU-RAM offload flag, or `--parallel 1`-freed KV? (For scale: the Flash-Next dual-Spark README describes that table as a single 51 GB file, so the number is *at* the 96 GB scale — please correct if Unsloth splits or shrinks it.) 
2. Did the ~100 tok/s baseline use the same KV quant / context / driver/runtime versions so the 1.7× is directly attributable to MTP alone? Was the 170 figure a single-stream measurement?
3. Does the shared Q8_0 MTP module's resident footprint deviate from the "96–114 GB" table the page gives for the 4-bit lane?

If you can share the run's conditions (container / version + offload tier), we'll pin them verbatim with attribution; sensitive-condition granularity is welcome even if it's only "CPU-RAM offload".
